about_blocks.text: Homewood Ravensview: Inpatient Addiction and Mental Health Care near Victoria, BC
about_blocks.html: Homewood Ravensview: Inpatient Addiction and Mental Health Care near Victoria, BC

about_blocks.text: Homewood Ravensview is a private inpatient centre in North Saanich, on the Saanich Peninsula about 25 minutes north of downtown Victoria. It treats addiction, depression, anxiety, trauma and PTSD, chronic pain and gambling disorder, and it is set up for people who have more than one of these at once. Homewood Health, the company behind Homewood Health Centre in Guelph, opened it in 2019 as its Western Canada site.

about_blocks.text: Stays are fixed lengths. Addiction treatment takes six weeks, and treatment for mental health or concurrent disorders takes nine. If you need to come off alcohol or drugs safely first, detox and withdrawal management happen on site. Nursing staff are there 24 hours a day, and the care team can include a psychiatrist, an addiction medicine physician, a psychologist, therapists, social workers and counsellors.

If you need to come off alcohol or drugs safely first, detox and withdrawal management happen on site. about_blocks.text: Most days have therapy in the morning and again in the afternoon, built around CBT, DBT, cognitive processing therapy and the Unified Protocol. Evenings tend to be art, music or horticultural therapy. Adults go through the Cornerstone program, young adults 19 and up go through My Path, and first responders, military members and veterans have their own program called Guardians. For treatment-resistant depression, the centre offers rTMS and an intranasal medication within the inpatient stay at no added cost.

about_blocks.text: The building sits on 28 forested acres on a mountainside the W̱SÁNEĆ people call ȽÁU,WELṈEW, next to John Dean Provincial Park. Rooms are semi-private, private or private suites, all with their own bathrooms, and many look out over the ocean and mountains. On site there is a gym, a yoga space, tennis and pickleball courts, art and music rooms, a horticulture garden, a meditation labyrinth and an outdoor cultural space. Homewood says it developed Ravensview together with local First Nation communities.

You do not need a referral to call the intake team.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Homewood Ravensview

faqs.question: How much does Homewood Ravensview cost?

answer_blocks.text: Ravensview does not publish its fees. The centre says cost depends on how long you stay and which room you choose (semi-private, private or a private suite), and its intake team goes through the options with you on the first call. Recovery.com also lists no prices for it.

faqs.question: How long is the program at Homewood Ravensview?

answer_blocks.text: Addiction treatment is a six-week inpatient stay. Treatment for depression, anxiety, trauma or concurrent disorders runs nine weeks. Every client also gets outpatient aftercare once they leave, according to the centre.

faqs.question: Where is Homewood Ravensview and how do I get there?

answer_blocks.text: Ravensview is at 1515 McTavish Road in North Saanich, on the Saanich Peninsula north of Victoria on Vancouver Island. It is about 5 minutes from Victoria International Airport, 10 minutes from the Swartz Bay ferry terminal and 25 minutes from downtown Victoria. Staff can pick you up at the airport or the ferry if you ask ahead.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral to go to Ravensview?

answer_blocks.text: No. You can call the intake team yourself for a confidential conversation. The centre also takes referrals from physicians, therapists, psychologists, employers and employee assistance programs, and the intake team decides with you whether inpatient care is the right fit.

faqs.question: Is Ravensview covered by MSP or my benefits?

answer_blocks.text: Ravensview is privately owned, so most people pay themselves or through employer coverage. The centre says some clients are funded through a provincial Ministry of Health, Workers Compensation Board or other third parties, and it accepts health identification cards from Veterans Affairs Canada and the RCMP. It is part of the WorkSafeBC Provider Network.

faqs.question: What happens after I leave Ravensview?

answer_blocks.text: Every client leaves with a structured aftercare plan written by a clinician, access to a recovery management support group and membership in the virtual Homewood Alumni Program. One-to-one counselling, step-down programming and substance use monitoring are also available afterwards at extra cost.

faqs.question: Can I use my phone or have visitors?

answer_blocks.text: Not during the first week. Personal technology is held for the first 7 days and then allowed at set times. Visits start on the first Sunday after your first 7 days and run on Sundays from 2:30 to 4:30 p.m. in the lounges, dining room or on the grounds.

faqs.question: Is Ravensview the same as Homewood Health Centre in Guelph?

answer_blocks.text: No. Both are run by Homewood Health, but Ravensview is a separate inpatient centre in North Saanich, BC, opened in 2019. Homewood Health Centre and The Residence at Homewood are in Guelph, Ontario, and have their own listings.
